Your HighLevel account got better this week. Here are the 5 updates worth your time.

1. Conversation AI now goes to sleep when your team replies from outside HighLevel, like Meta Business Suite. Email replies are not covered yet.
2. HighLevel says Meeting Rooms are now HIPAA compliant, and recording asks for a confirmation before it starts.
3. New Events elements put all your events on one website or funnel page, with ticket checkout. Turn on Events in Labs first.
4. Managed Agents can now run before a meeting starts or after it ends, filtered by calendar and meeting type.
5. Workflows can fill date-time contact fields with dynamic values, so reminders and follow-ups land on the right day.

Want help setting any of these up? The link is in the first comment.

Send this to whoever runs your HighLevel account.

body.summary:
Your HighLevel account got better this week. Here are the 5 updates worth your time.

Every Friday I go through the HighLevel changelog so you don't have to. These five updates from this week matter most for business owners:

1. Conversation AI now goes to sleep when your team replies from outside HighLevel, like Meta Business Suite. Email replies are not covered yet.
2. HighLevel says Meeting Rooms are now HIPAA compliant, and recording asks for a confirmation before it starts.
3. New Events elements put all your events on one website or funnel page, with ticket checkout. Turn on Events in Labs first.
4. Managed Agents can now run before a meeting starts or after it ends, filtered by calendar and meeting type.
5. Workflows can fill date-time contact fields with dynamic values, so reminders and follow-ups land on the right day.

The one I'd watch: the Conversation AI fix. If your team jumps into a Facebook or Instagram conversation from Meta Business Suite, the bot now goes quiet, the same as when you reply inside HighLevel. That means fewer awkward double replies. It applies to bots on Auto Pilot with Manual Message turned on, and email replies are not covered yet.

If you want any of these set up in your account, the link is in the first comment.

Send this to whoever runs your HighLevel account.

#HighLevel #MarketingAutomation #SmallBusiness
